description: THE TRANSACTION-TYPE NOT-FOUND ABEND ON THE FIRST RECORD, and the one case in this set that proves the ORDER of the three keyed lookups rather than merely that each of them exists. Record 1 carries a card number that resolves and a transaction type code that does not, so 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF succeeds and 1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE (app/cbl/CBTRN03C.cbl:494-502) then fails - and the run ends inside the type lookup having written nothing at all, not even a header. THE KEY IS VERIFIED ABSENT. TRAN-TYPE-CD is '99' at bytes 17-18, and app/data/ASCII/trantype.txt holds exactly seven rows whose keys are 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06 and 07 - Purchase, Payment, Credit, Authorization, Refund, Reversal and Adjustment - so '99' is not among them and the keyed READ cannot succeed, it can only take its INVALID KEY arm. Had it succeeded it would have filled TRAN-TYPE-RECORD as app/cpy/CVTRA03Y.cpy declares it: TRAN-TYPE PIC X(02) at bytes 1-2, TRAN-TYPE-DESC PIC X(50) at 3-52 and FILLER PIC X(08) at 53-60, which the fixture fills with the literal 00000000 - sixty bytes, none of which this run ever reads. THE CARD, BY CONTRAST, RESOLVES. TRAN-CARD-NUM is 0500024453765740 at bytes 263-278, which is row 1 of app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt and maps to XREF-CUST-ID 000000050 and XREF-ACCT-ID 00000000050, so the cross-reference read at :485 takes its normal path. That path emits NO message - 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF displays only on failure - so the absence of an 'INVALID CARD NUMBER : ' line in the expectation below is not an omission, it is positive evidence that the read succeeded. CARDXREF is seeded from the fixture at its real 36 bytes and the case declares CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50, so app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy's trailing FILLER PIC X(14) at bytes 37-50 is supplied once at seed time rather than pre-baked into a tenth fixture (gate G16, risk R-F). ORDERING IS WHAT THIS CASE PINS. The loop body at :179-196 is a fixed sequence: DISPLAY TRAN-RECORD at :180, then the card-break block at :181-188 whose last act is PERFORM 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF at :187, then MOVE TRAN-TYPE-CD OF TRAN-RECORD TO FD-TRAN-TYPE at :189 and PERFORM 1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE at :190, then the two MOVEs into FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY at :191-194 and PERFORM 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG at :195, and only then PERFORM 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT at :196. Because the type lookup abends, 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG never runs, 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT never runs, and 1120-WRITE-HEADERS - reachable only from inside 1100, through the WS-FIRST-TIME block at :275-280 - never runs either. So the report holds zero records, not four headers and a truncated detail. An implementation that resolved all three lookups eagerly, or that reordered them so the category or the cross-reference were consulted first, would emit a different diagnostic here and this case would catch it. TRAN-CAT-CD IS DELIBERATELY VALID. It is 0001 at bytes 19-22, which pairs with any of the seven real type codes to form a key trancatg.txt actually holds - 010001 is 'Regular Sales Draft' - so the only thing wrong with record 1 is its type code. Had the lookups been reordered, the category read would have been asked for 990001 and failed for a second, independent reason; pinning the type message rather than merely pinning an abend is what keeps this case from passing for the wrong reason. THE RANGE IS A DATASET, NEVER A PARM. app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl:59 gives STEP10R no PARM whatsoever, so jobParameters is empty and 0550-DATEPARM-READ at :220-243 is the only source of WS-START-DATE and WS-END-DATE. The seeded DATEPARM row is 80 bytes - two PIC X(10) dates around a single-byte separator followed by 59 spaces, exactly the shape app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl:117-121 lays out in FILLER-3 of the JCL skeleton it submits - and the READ DATE-PARMS-FILE INTO WS-DATEPARM-RECORD at :221 right-truncates it into the 21-byte WS-DATEPARM-RECORD of :122-125. TRAN-PROC-TS begins 2022-04-18, inside the inclusive range, so the test at :173-174 passes and the detail path at :179 is entered rather than the NEXT SENTENCE arm at :177. THE DIAGNOSTIC TRAIL IS SIX DISPLAY LINES AND NO SEVENTH. :160 the start banner. :232-233 'Reporting from ' with the two dates. :180 DISPLAY TRAN-RECORD, which fires BEFORE any lookup and emits the whole 350-byte group item untrimmed - TRAN-AMT at bytes 133-143 as its stored zoned image 0000001234E, which is +123.45 because PIC S9(09)V99 occupies eleven bytes and carries the sign overpunched into the trailing byte ({ABCDEFGHI for +0 through +9 and }JKLMNOPQR for -0 through -9, as app/data/ASCII/dailytran.txt confirms with 0000005047G = +504.77, 0000000678H = +67.88 and 0000000259R = -25.99), and FILLER at bytes 331-350 as its twenty spaces. Then :497 DISPLAY 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE : ' concatenated with the two-byte FD-TRAN-TYPE of :74, which is 27 + 2 = 29 characters and echoes exactly the key the read used - two bytes, not the sixteen the cross-reference arm echoes nor the six the category arm echoes. Then :498-499 MOVE 23 TO IO-STATUS and PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS. THE STATUS LINE IS DERIVED, NOT ASSUMED. 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at :633-646 tests IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' at :634-635. IO-STATUS holds '23', which IS numeric, and IO-STAT1 is '2' rather than '9', so both halves are false and the ELSE arm at :641-644 runs: MOVE '0000' TO IO-STATUS-04, then MOVE IO-STATUS TO IO-STATUS-04(3:2), whose reference modification overwrites positions 3 and 4 of that '0000' and leaves '0023', then DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04 emits the literal followed by those four digits: FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0023, 20 + 4 = 24 characters. The doubled NNNN is not a transcription slip - the literal in the source really is 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' and the four-character image follows it - so it is reproduced verbatim. Finally :500 PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM, which at :626-630 displays ABENDING PROGRAM, moves 0 to TIMING, moves 999 to ABCODE and reaches CALL 'CEE3ABD' at :630 - a BARE call with no USING clause. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN IS HALF THE ASSERTION. There is no 'INVALID CARD NUMBER : ' line, because the cross-reference read succeeded. There is no 'INVALID TRAN CATG KEY : ' line, because 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG is never reached - which is the whole point of the ordering proof. There are no 'TRAN-AMT ' or 'WS-PAGE-TOTAL' lines, because those belong to the end-of-file arm at :198-199 and the loop never reaches end of file. Record 2 is never read at all: it is seeded fully valid on card 0500024453765740, type 01 and category 0001, so every one of its three lookups would have resolved and its non-processing is observable rather than merely assumed. The six close paragraphs at :208-213 never run. And END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C at :215 is never emitted, which is the clearest signature separating an abend from a normal termination - the message list asserts that absence by having no seventh entry. THE RETURN CODE IS DERIVED RATHER THAN GUESSED. CBTRN03C contains zero references to RETURN-CODE, verified by exhaustive search, so the severity travels in APPL-RESULT and in ABCODE 999 alone; the migration's common.AbendException carries 12, which is AbendException.RETURN_CODE_IO_ERROR and the MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT value every WHEN OTHER arm of this program uses, and the three keyed lookups never touch APPL-RESULT at all so the same fatal value serves them. 12 is what case16 states for the cross-reference arm and what case20 states for this same type arm failing after five records, and that consistency is deliberate: cases disagreeing about the exit code of the one CALL 'CEE3ABD' at :630 would fail gate G18 for this module (gate G35). THE RECORD CHANNELS BOTH HOLD NOTHING, for two different reasons. TRANREPT is opened by 0100-REPTFILE-OPEN and never written, so the writes channel is empty; and app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl:76-80 declares it DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE), whose third positional deletes the generation on an abnormal end, so the final state is empty too. Both are declared at the 133 bytes DCB=(LRECL=133,RECFM=FB,BLKSIZE=0) at :78 fixes, which is how a case pins the identity of a dataset that has no row whose width could be checked. Gates G20 and G21 are therefore satisfied VACUOUSLY here - no record width is proved and no FILLER span is emitted, because nothing is written - and this case says so rather than appearing to prove a width it never wrote. GATE G47 is the other half of this case: the '23' not-found outcome of the transaction-type call site, whose '00' found outcome case06, case08 and case09 cover among the runs that resolve every key. The three INVALID KEY arms are identical in shape - display, MOVE 23 TO IO-STATUS, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM - and differ only in the message literal and the echoed key width, sixteen bytes for the cross-reference at :487, two here at :497 and six for the category at :507, so the cases that pin them are kept mutually consistent. Gate G30 holds throughout: both EVALUATE statements keep WHEN OTHER last, and this run takes '00' on the DATEPARM read at :222-229 and '00' on the TRANFILE read at :251-258, reaching neither '10' nor WHEN OTHER on either. Gate G51: the unit is the tasklet, invoked with no JobLauncher and no HTTP layer in the path. Gate G23: the seeded amount carries scale exactly 2, as PIC S9(09)V99 declares; gate G24: ROUNDED appears zero times in this program, verified, so every store truncates toward zero - though no arithmetic completes in this case at all, because 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT and its ADDs at :287-288 are never reached. transaction.TranTypeRepository SURFACES the not-found outcome rather than abending on its caller's behalf, so the display-then-abend sequence belongs to transaction.TransactionReportJob and the expectation is attributed there; TRANTYPE is read by CBTRN03C alone among the 28 programs, so this folder is the only place its not-found path is ever exercised. CBTRN03C has zero GO TO, verified, so this path is reached by ordinary PERFORM nesting rather than by a jump. PRACTICE B5: nothing here is handled more gracefully than the COBOL handles it. The program abends on an unknown transaction type rather than skipping the record, defaulting the description or logging a warning, and the expectation says so - an empty report, a deleted generation and a non-zero exit code - because any of those kinder outcomes would be a new feature and a parity violation. PRACTICE B12: every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy's 350-byte layout, app/cpy/CVTRA03Y.cpy's 60-byte layout, app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy's 50-byte layout, the DD, DCB and DISP contracts of app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl and app/proc/TRANREPT.prc, and the real US-ASCII fixtures under app/data/ASCII - never captured from a live COBOL run, which section 0.7.6 of the plan proves impossible in this environment with eight independently verified blockers (risk R-A).
